question: With the Line Numbers setting on 'relative' the gutter shows distances from my cursor line (and the absolute number on the cursor line itself), and with 'interval' only every 10th line, the cursor line and the last line are numbered. Where is the text of each gutter number decided?

question: The 'Delete Duplicate Lines' command removes repeated lines, keeping only the first copy of each. With just a caret on one line it cleans up the whole file, but with a selection it only looks inside the selected lines. Where is that implemented?

notes: Read linesOperations.ts DeleteDuplicateLinesAction.run (Set-based dedupe, whole-document fallback).

question: On macOS, Ctrl+T swaps the two characters around the caret, but when the caret is at the very end of a line it swaps the two characters before it instead, and at the start of the file it does nothing. Where is that swapping logic implemented?
expected: The Transpose Letters editor action, TransposeLettersAction.run, computes for each empty selection the left/right characters (special-casing end of line and the file start) and pushes a ReplaceCommand that writes them in reverse order.
notes: Read caretOperations/browser/transpose.ts: run() builds endPosition/middlePosition/beginPosition with MoveOperations and replaces with rightChar+leftChar.

question: In a plain list (for example a list of items in a panel), if I just start typing letters while it has focus, the highlight jumps to the next entry whose label starts with what I typed, and if nothing starts with it, to one that matches loosely; after I stop typing for a moment it starts over. TypeNavigationController.enable sets up the keydown stream and the 800 ms debounce that clears the typed word.
notes: Read listWidget.ts TypeNavigationController: enable() builds onChar/onClear (800ms debounce) and onInput reduces chars; onInput does matchesPrefix then matchesFuzzy2 and setFocus/reveal.

question: When I click on the empty track of a scrollbar (above or below the thumb, not on the thumb itself), the view jumps so that the click point lands in the middle of the thumb; with the 'scroll by page' option turned on, the same click instead moves exactly one page up or down. notes: Read abstractScrollbar.ts _onPointerDown (this._scrollByPage ? ...Paged : ...) and scrollbarState.ts.

question: When some tool deletes a file and immediately re-creates it, VS Code gets a single 'changed' notification instead of a delete plus a create; a file that is created and deleted again in the same burst produces no notification at all; and when a whole folder is deleted only the folder is reported, not every file inside it. question: When I drag the divider between two stacked panes and hold Alt while dragging, the pane next to the divider grows or shrinks on both sides at once (symmetrically) instead of only one neighbour giving up space, and pressing or releasing Alt in the middle of the drag switches modes. question: With scroll-on-middle-click enabled, pressing the mouse wheel button drops a dot and the editor then keeps scrolling faster the further I move the pointer away from it, ignoring tiny movements; any key press or a click ends it. Where is this auto-scroll implemented?

question: Some completion entries are accepted automatically when I type a character such as '.' or '(' while they are highlighted in the list (controlled by 'editor.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter'). question: When I run Format Selection (Ctrl+K Ctrl+F) without selecting anything, the whole line the caret is on gets reformatted rather than nothing. Where is the empty selection widened to the line before the selection formatter is asked?

question: When I move the cursor into another function, the breadcrumb path above the editor changes only at its end; the leading segments (folders, file name) are kept as they are and only the differing trailing segments are redrawn, reusing the existing DOM nodes where possible. question: Built-in commands declare a default shortcut plus optional separate shortcuts for Windows, macOS and Linux. When such a default shortcut is registered, where is the variant for the current operating system picked?

question: In VS Code for the Web, copying still works in browsers where the async Clipboard API throws because of security policies. Where is the fallback that copies via a hidden 1px textarea and document.execCommand('copy')?

question: When the function-signature popup lists several overloads ('1/3'), Alt+Down / Alt+Up step through them. If 'editor.parameterHints.cycle' is off, stepping past the last (or before the first) overload closes the popup instead of wrapping. Where is that decided?

question: I select some text and drag it with the mouse to another spot in the same file; it moves there (or is duplicated if I hold Ctrl/Alt while dropping) and the dropped text ends up selected. Where are the edits and the resulting selection computed?

notes: Read dragAndDropCommand.ts and dnd.ts _onEditorMouseDrop.

question: When the peek window with all references of a symbol opens, the entry highlighted first is the one closest to where my cursor was, preferring hits in the same file. Where is that closest entry chosen?

notes: Read referencesModel.ts nearestReference and referencesController.ts toggleWidget (the 'best' selection).

question: When a right-click entry with a chevron is near the right edge of the window, its nested submenu pops out to the left of the parent instead of the right, and if there is no room on either side it overlaps the parent slightly offset; near the bottom it is pushed up. question: With editor.hover.enabled set to 'onKeyboardModifier', the hover only appears while I hold the modifier opposite to the multi-cursor one (Ctrl/Cmd if multi-cursor uses Alt). Which code calls the shared helper that checks whether that trigger modifier is held?

question: With 'editor.suggestSelection' (first / recentlyUsed / recentlyUsedByPrefix), VS Code decides which entry of the completion list is highlighted first, using a remembered history. Which code asks that history service which entry to pre-highlight?

question: Go to Definition, Go to Declaration, Go to Type Definition, Go to Implementations and Find All References all gather their results from every registered language extension through one shared helper that asks each provider and drops locations from internal schemes. question: Panes in a resizable row/column container can be told to share the space equally. notes: b11_truth callers CursorUndoRedoController._applyState -> 2; read cursorUndo.ts.

question: With the caret on 1.5, Replace with Next Value (Ctrl+Shift+.) turns it into 1.6, and on 'true' it gives 'false'. The new value is computed off the UI thread. Trace from the background-side handler that receives the request to the place where a number gets bumped.

question: When I drag the divider between side-by-side panes past a pane's minimum width, some panes simply stop at their minimum, but others suddenly vanish completely once I go about half of their minimum beyond it, and come back if I drag back. question: A screen reader user reports that when the same polite announcement is triggered twice in a row (for example stepping through history to an identical value), they still hear it the second time, and that a huge message is read out only partially. notes: Read aria.ts status/alert/insertMessage.

question: In settings.json I have a block for several languages at once ("[javascript][typescript]") setting the tab size to 2 and a block for TypeScript alone setting it to 4. In .ts files I always get 4, whatever order the blocks appear in. Also, for an object-valued setting, the language block's keys are merged into the general value instead of replacing it. question: The box that outlines the bracket matching the one next to my cursor sometimes isn't drawn: not when I have a non-empty selection, not when there are more than about a hundred cursors, and not when the editor isn't focused.
